name: Kasumisan# -Manatsu no Refrain-
source:
On the first day of summer vacations main character's female friend dies in a traffic accident. That was a huge blow for him. When he awakens the next day it's again July 31st, first day of summer vacations. Two worlds of past and present form an eternal cycle to reveal hidden heart strings.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假第一天，主角的一位女性朋友死於車禍，這件事讓他深受打擊。然而第二天醒來時，時間又回到了7月31日——暑假的第一天。過去與現在兩個世界構成永恆的循環，逐漸揭開深藏心底的情感。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
